I replied to Dana Okafor in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **ticket #4092**.

That comes from Ilse Varga's message in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55). Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. Ilse said IT has #4092 open to replace the hub, and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table because that resets the Polycom. I passed that warning on too.

Dana has a DM with me where she guesses the ticket "ends up at OPS-5546 next year." I left it out of the channel reply because she asked me to keep it private. It's also only her guess, not a real ticket number.
